title: Ulyana and the Border
author: Mara Nakamura
blurb: Kestrel Halloran, a whistle-blower living under four names, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
